summary: Locked 2.39:1 widescreen. Extreme wide vistas cut against tight eye close-ups. Long tense holds, then sharp cuts. Mostly a still camera, with slow push-ins. Warm sun-bleached 1960s film look, with grain. Harsh sun. Dusty palette.

lenses.name: extreme wide
lenses.use: Extreme wide vistas. The land is larger than the rider.

framing.description: Extreme wide vistas cut against tight eye close-ups.
Long holds, then sharp cuts. Mostly a still camera, with slow push-ins.

lighting.description: Harsh sun. Dust in the air. The day moves from amber to bronze to rose to blue dusk.
